core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khatija is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pure and Chaste”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khatija corresponds to the Arabic form خديجة (Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja)). Its core sense is khadija; a female given name. Khatija is a South Asian transliteration of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), a well-documented female given name borne by Khadija bint Khuwaylid. The source gloss 'Pure and Chaste' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as khadeejah, khadejah, khadiga, khadija, khadijah, khadijeh and khatijah.
